QuestInfo.name: Mysterious Invitation
QuestInfo.0: You raised your Level thanks to the Headmaster's suggestion. The Resistance should be contacting you soon, but you still wonder how they will do it... In any case, the Headmaster seems to have something to say to you. Go see #b#p2152000##k in front of the school.
QuestInfo.1:
The headmaster congratulates you for raising your level and wants to give you a gift. He says you can find it inside the nearby pipe. What would it be doing in there...? Only one way to find out, you suppose.

#bEnter the pipe to the left of the Edelstein kindergarten.#k
QuestInfo.2:
You went through the pip and found the Resistance Hideout! Not only that, Doctor #p2151003#, or rather, #p2151003# the Resistance member was there as well! The other people you saw in town were all there, but they looked different too! Even the headmaster...he was the leader of the Resistance! The band of kindred spirits fighting the tyranny of the Black Wings are none other than the unassuming townspeople of Edelestein!

If you want to become a member of the Resistance to fight for peace and freedom, choose your Job now!
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
Can proceed to Path of the Battle Mage
Can proceed to Path of the Wild Hunter
Can proceed to Path of a Mechanic
Can proceed to Sulfur and Iron - The Blaster's Path

0.0: #h0#! You've reached Lv. 10! Marvelous. Allow me to reward you for doing such a great job. \r\n(There is a twinkle in the Headmaster's eye.)\r\nIt's something I know you've wanted for a while...

yes.0: #bOpen the Use tab of your inventory and use the invitation I just gave you#k. Do so right away. You won't regret it.

no.0: You don't even want to know what the reward is? Are you sure? It's something I know you've been wanting...

1.0: Welcome, #h0#! Surprised to see me? Well, don't be. We've all been waiting for you... Look around. You'll see a lot of faces you recognize.
1.1: Yes, we're all part of the #b#m310000000# Resistance#k. We live normal lives in town and we pretend to be subservient and meek, but we're actually preparing to fight. The Headmaster is our training instructor.
1.2: Now, I don't think anyone has explained to you who our enemies are, though I'm sure you've seen them around. They wear black clothes, and they're called the #rBlack Wings#k. They've come to Edelstein to steal our resources... and our freedom.
1.3: We pretend to obey the Black Wings. Things are safer that way. But here, in secret, some citizens of Edelstein are preparing to fight them. We protect young residents like you by keeping you in the dark.
1.4: But we never planned to keep it a secret from you forever. So since you've found out about the Black Wings anyway, we'd like to invite you to join the Resistance.
1.5: But take heed. Once you join the Resistance, you will encounter endless challenges and danger. You will struggle. You could give it your all and sacrifice everything for Edelstein, and in the end...we may fail. We may not be able to defeat the Black Wings.
1.6: But the people you see here, we've chosen this path because we believe it is the right thing to do. Freedom and peace are worth fighting for, even if we end up losing. That is what it means to be part of the Resistance.
1.7: So, #h0#... \r\nWill you join us in this dangerous venture?\r\n

yes.0: I knew you wouldn't be able to resist this opportunity. Good, next you must choose your path. Think about your strengths and personality before you make a decision.
yes.1: Talk to each job instructor and listen carefully to their job descriptions before you #bchoose your path#k. Once you do, your new job instructor will advance you as an official member of the Resistance. Think of your job instructor as an extracurricular teacher.
yes.2: Come see me after you advance as an official member of the Resistance. I will then explain to you the required training and missions you will receive.
